agastya_singh_tomar_: The sergeant gave Jonas "Ash" Tomar a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Jonas "Ash" Tomar watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-C10 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Tobias "Mud" Broccoli was gravely wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Jonas "Ash" Tomar did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Jonas "Ash" Tomar waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Pavel Tsanev did, and was gravely wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas "Ash" Tomar is number 760. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jonas "Ash" Tomar helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Jonas "Ash" Tomar changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Jonas "Ash" Tomar agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
aleksandar.kole: The draft reached T-F6 on Day 10. Severin Kole was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Face blackened with soot, Severin Kole spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Cyril Sebastian was badly wounded. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Severin Kole helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Magpie. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Magpie hit all three. Severin Kole watched where the shots came from.
Severin Kole fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Isidor Preston was gravely wounded.
braden_larson21: The new rifleman is Benedikt Larson, once a coal miner from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Benedikt Larson said he would find out.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Benedikt Larson during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A round went through the rim of Benedikt Larson's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Lucien Odin of the Concord (@odin21320). On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt Larson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet went through Benedikt Larson's upper arm at S-R16 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec of the Concord (@crabbithesecond). A single shot at S-R16. Benedikt Larson sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec of the Concord (@crabbithesecond).
The papers say Walter "Brick" Larson. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Benedikt Larson's eyes. Nobody in S-R16 argues.
Walter "Brick" Larson is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
ech0_42: Severin Ech joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Severin Ech shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A rat stole Severin Ech's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Ech. Severin Ech read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Severin Ech walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Severin Ech counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Cyril Ramaci was grazed.

Severin Ech was hit in the forearm at S-R2. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam of the Concord (@henrywestgaming1812).
eugeneous911: Roland Eugeneous came up the line with a stub of a pencil and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Roland Eugeneous waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Felix Nickloser did, and was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Roland Eugeneous helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Roland Eugeneous had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Karel Pasoslargos was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Eugeneous. Roland Eugeneous read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-S6. Roland Eugeneous has learned to walk bent double.
Dawn watch. Roland Eugeneous put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Ulrich Nshill, gravely wounded.

Roland Eugeneous found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Eugeneous. Roland Eugeneous read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
evaglane: The draft reached N-F9 on Day 13. Walter Evaglane was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
jere.hsrr: Day 9. The corporal put Florian Hsrr beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Florian Hsrr went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Rafael "Bones" Gaita put up a fight, but not for long. (@gaita_4119) Florian Hsrr jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Norbert Fransinlak. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@fransinlak) Florian Hsrr came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Florian Hsrr is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Florian Hsrr looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Hsrr. Florian Hsrr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian Hsrr survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-C7, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian Hsrr is number 664. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Florian Hsrr wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Florian Hsrr had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Matthias Mihai was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Hsrr. Florian Hsrr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Florian Hsrr held the mirror while Emil Only shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
keegan7.92: Walter "Whistle" Keegan took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

A bullet hit Walter "Whistle" Keegan in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F16. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03). Walter "Whistle" Keegan stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03).

A letter came with Karel "Lucky" Keegan: "I am Walter "Whistle" Keegan's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Karel "Lucky" Keegan transferred to the machine gunners. The men in Q-F16 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. Grey Mill has been won. Karel "Lucky" Keegan listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Dawn watch. Karel "Lucky" Keegan put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Leopold "Tin" Jake, grazed. A letter from home found Karel "Lucky" Keegan before the night shift. Karel "Lucky" Keegan folded it small and kept it close.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Karel "Lucky" Keegan as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
masondevos19: The old hands of P-F10 have been here since Day 1. Dorian Masondevos has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Dorian Masondevos and Roland Rudransh carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at P-F10 changed before the cheering ended. Dorian Masondevos shouldered another load.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Dorian Masondevos held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
Fog so thick that Dorian Masondevos could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
rattamus2_1: Yann Rattamus came up on Day 9 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Yann Rattamus had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Cyril Raphixdx was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Yann Rattamus watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home reached Yann Rattamus before dusk. Yann Rattamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Yann Rattamus shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner, was grazed. A letter from home reached Yann Rattamus before dusk. Yann Rattamus read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann Rattamus stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet went through Yann Rattamus's sleeve at S-R18 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). A letter from home reached Yann Rattamus before dusk. Yann Rattamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Three days with a bandage, and Yann Rattamus is back at S-R18. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home reached Yann Rattamus before dusk. Yann Rattamus read it twice and slept a little easier.
rebootrebooted: Wendel Rebootreboot was a fisherman in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to V-F14 with a key to a house that is no longer there, and within a day the whole squad knew that he knows every star by name.
Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Hanging Bridge. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Wendel Rebootreboot: 'Fair trade.'
roryhacon: Emil Roryhacon arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R5 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Emil Roryhacon read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet grazed Emil Roryhacon's ribs at S-R5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Felix Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._). Emil Roryhacon got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 919. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Emil Roryhacon heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Emil Roryhacon was carrying water up to S-R5 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Emil Roryhacon did not. Shot by Ivo Pejo of the Hegemony (@aki_pejo01). Emil Roryhacon was killed at S-R5 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Ivo Pejo of the Hegemony (@aki_pejo01).
Isidor Roryhacon asked about Emil Roryhacon on arriving at S-R5. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Isidor Roryhacon was found at the bottom of the trench at S-R5, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Gustav Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike). Isidor Roryhacon was hit at S-R5 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Gustav Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike).
Walter "Parson" Roryhacon put a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts beside the bunk. Someone who had known Isidor Roryhacon helped clear the shelf without saying why.
siddharth_guy: Leopold "Tin" Guy walked into U-F9 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Leopold "Tin" Guy has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Otto "Rabbit" Astra, grazed. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Tin" Guy watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Leopold "Tin" Guy across the shin at U-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Hugo Suzumi of the Hegemony (@me._.suzumi).
Leopold "Tin" Guy's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at U-F9 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
stefmichael_96: Albin "Doc" Stefmichael came up on Day 10 carrying news from Old Harrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Albin "Doc" Stefmichael fixed the strap on Teodor Serdr's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F14. Albin "Doc" Stefmichael has learned to walk bent double.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Albin "Doc" Stefmichael held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
Albin "Doc" Stefmichael dreamt he was back in Old Harrow, working as a shepherd. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
supergreen_123: Edmund Supergreen joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik snores. Edmund Supergreen does not. Edmund now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Supergreen kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Edmund Supergreen obtained a recipe for a batch of potato cakes. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Edmund Supergreen closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
sureshot1021: The quartermaster asked Rafael "Saint" Sureshot to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Rafael "Saint" Sureshot wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Rafael "Saint" Sureshot. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
Inkwell the crow follows Rafael "Saint" Sureshot along the trench now. When Inkwell flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
